**Verdict: no required change.**
- The attachment composes three canonical results on one family, table and ordered filter, with the row chosen before every spectator tuple and test: the insertion relay (inclusion part only), the finite-rank exact kernel, and the normalized compact-test lemma of ope-filtration. It yields exactly the simultaneous tested input (154).
- The every-character proof establishes operator equality B = B′ from all dense positive-word matrix elements before any character is applied. So the same raw K_{de} work for every character, slot and raw exterior, with no exceptional set and no multiplicativity of the extended character.
- The source crosswalk matches `YM.Work.B09.Evaluates.inclusions` (via `tester_ext`, `matrix_at_center`, `DiffPlan.Inclusions.kernels`), `YM.Dash.Spans.r`/`TestPlan`/`Added`/`brace`/`lifts_model`, and the caller `YM.Work.B09.answer`.

Minor findings:
- N1: `ex-phase-original-null` is cited outside its section's standing hypotheses. The use is sound, because the lemma's proof needs only what 39.5 assumes; one clause should say so.
- N2: smoothness clauses of the reused propositions should read "continuous" unless `ex-phase-caps` is invoked.

Optional findings:
- O1: one name for the relay's inverse-terminal, bare and inverse-calibrated subpower norms.
- O2: one sentence on why per-basis-label refinements are harmless.
- O3: `Paragraph~\ref{par:...}` renders as the subsection number.
